THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The petitioner - accused No.2, who is sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506(B) of IPC, is before this Court.

2. The case of the prosecution is that, the accused No.1 is the husband of the defacto complainant,
and he subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty both mentally and physically.
The allegation against the accused No.2 is that, she is having an illicit relationship with the accused No.1, and at her instance, the accused No.1 subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty.
The cognizance taken of the aforesaid offences is impugned in this petition.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
4. Perusal of the charge sheet material indicates that, there is no allegation that, the accused No.2 in the presence of the defacto complainant instigated the accused No.1 to subject her cruelty.
Except the omnibus and general allegation that the NC: 2023:KHC:28863 accused No.2 instigated the accused No.1, there is no material to substantiate the said allegation.

The charge sheet material does not contain any material that, the petitioner - accused No.2 is the relative, much less, far relative of the accused No.1 so as to invoke the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC.

Hence, the charge sheet laid only on the basis of omnibus and general allegation, in the absence of any material that, the accused No.2 instigated the accused No.1, the continuation of criminal proceeding will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
